final: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) v FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.* FROM t, b1 WHERE t.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) v FROM k1), f AS (SELECT k1.a FROM k1, b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS mean_avg, AVG(f.a - b1.v) AS mean_excess_b1, AVG(f.a - b2.v) AS mean_excess_b2 FROM f, b1, b2
